sentences.text: This criminal petition has been filed by the petitioner praying for quashing of the Charge-sheet No. 18/2023 as well as the FIR which is registered as Bijni P.S. Case No. 200/2022 under Section 376 of the IPC.

3. According to the learned counsel for the petitioner, the dispute between the petitioner and the respondent No. 2 originates from the issue pertaining to the appointment of the petitioner as a Gaonburah.

After the petitioner was appointed as a Gaonburah of Batabar Village under Chirang District, some persons inimical to the petitioner has instigated the respondent No. 2 and consequently the FIR dated 28.11.2022 was lodged which was registered as Bijni P.S. Case No.
200/2022 under Section 376 of the IPC.
4.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the respondent No. 2 has now realized her mistake and has executed a memorandum of mutual settlement-cum-deed of agreement dated 06.04.2023, wherein it is stated that the respondent No. 2 has filed the FIR due to misunderstanding and undue influence of some other persons.
It is further stated that both parties namely the petitioner and the respondent No. 2 have amicably settled the dispute outside the Court and they are living peacefully as earlier.
In addition thereto, an affidavit to the said effect has also been filed executed by the respondent Page No.# 3/3 No. 2.

The said affidavit is also enclosed to the criminal petition as annexure-10.
5.
Under the circumstances, the learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the entire case having been lodged by the respondent No. 2 under the undue influence of some other persons.

The allegations made in the FIR are on the face of it, cannot be accepted to be correct and therefore, this petition has been filed praying for quashing of the FIR along with the charge-sheet and further proceeding in the case before the Competent Court.
6.
Upon hearing the learned counsels for the parties, let Notices be issued, Returnable four weeks.
7. As the learned Addl. Public Prosecutor, Assam has accepted notice on behalf of the respondent No. 1, no formal notice needs to be issued to her.
8. Steps for service of notice on respondent No. 2 be taken by registered post with A/D within a period of one week from today.
Dasti is also permitted to be routed through the Registry of this Court.

9. In the meanwhile, further proceedings connected to Bijni P.S. Case No. 200/2022 under Section 376 of the IPC wherein Charge-sheet No. 18/2023 which is pending before the Court of SDJM, Bijni be stayed until the next date.

10. List this matter again on 26.05.2023.
